paper_title: Enhancing Multimodal LLM for Detailed and Accurate Video Captioning   using Multi-Round Preference Optimization
caption: : Video type distribution.
model_annotation: The pie chart illustrates the distribution of video types across various categories, representing their relative proportions in the dataset used for the study on enhancing multimodal LLMs for video captioning via multi-round preference optimization. The chart is divided into 13 distinct segments, each labeled with a category and its corresponding percentage. The largest segment is "People Blogs" at 17.2%, followed by "Entertainment" at 13.9%, and "Howto Style" at 9.7%. Other notable categories include "Education" (8.7%), "Sports" (7.7%), and "Gaming" (6.4%). Smaller segments include "Film Animation" (4.6%), "Travel Events" (4.6%), "Comedy" (5.6%), "Science Technology" (4.3%), "News Politics" (3.9%), "Pets Animals" (4.8%), and "Music" (2.3%). Each slice is color-coded for visual distinction, and percentages are clearly labeled within or adjacent to the respective segments. The chart appears to be arranged in descending order of proportion, starting from the largest segment at the top right and proceeding clockwise. There is no visible legend, but the labels are directly associated with their respective slices. The visual emphasizes the diversity of video content types, with "People Blogs" and "Entertainment" being the most prevalent, while "Music" is the least represented.
